schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom quantitative_result kind requires an exposure context. Descriptive numeric case observations such as intraocular pressure, prism diopters, exophthalmometry, and corneal dimensions have no defensible intervention/exposure role in this case series. They are preserved as qualitative_result atoms with numeric_descriptive_observation tags rather than fabricating an exposure.
The schema has no dedicated case_report_observation or clinical_recommendation atom kind. Case findings use qualitative_result and author recommendations use author_conclusion.
extraction_limitations: This is a three-patient descriptive case series with no comparator, prespecified analytic endpoint, or inferential statistical analysis.
The source does not provide a formal case-ascertainment method, inclusion criteria, or systematic literature-search method for the discussion statement that 38 cases had been reported.
All model-extracted atoms remain needs_review because no independent human review step is represented.
No external web verification was performed because @VERIFY was not activated.
protocol_version_note: Project instructions designate summary-evaluation-appraisal-protocol-v4-compact.md as governing, although the file internal heading reads Integrated Compact v3. The v4-named file was followed by precedence.
